items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Jimmy Lee; the interviewer mentions seeing a picture with Jimmy Lee, but the interviewee only confirms seeing a picture with Charlie Cook.

ctx.x: No, at that corner there was where the bar was on one side and the office was on the opposite side. But the bandstand was way up about the center and in the later days, it was in the center of the floor. Right in the very center, the people used to dance around us.
Yeah, I remember now seeing a picture with Jimmy Lee sitting on the... That's right. ...and that's when Cook was there.
We had a picture there with Charlie Cook because Charlie Cook followed me in there. I've seen that picture. Well, that was put right in the center of the ballroom.
